newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Xpress Q3 hurt by higher fuel prices.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Xpress Q3 hurt by higher fuel prices.

text.p: U.S. Xpress Enterprises Inc said on Wednesday that higher fuel prices hurt third quarter results by $0.03 a share, compared to the previous third quarter.

U.S. Xpress reported earnings of $0.20 a share on revenues of $89.9 million for the thrid quarter ended December 31, 1996, compared to $0.05 a share on revenues of $81.8 million the previous third quarter.
The company said that third quarter revenue was reduced by $2.7 million by a change in revenue recognition for financial reporting purposes.
The company previously recognized revnue and the related cost when freigth was dispatched.
Now it recognizes revenue and direct costs for each shipment when the shipment is completed.
